notes.title: Update 1.0.4 - October 28, 2020
notes.notes:
Hello Burrowers,

Update 1.0.4 is here, bringing a minor bug fix.

* Fixed a bug in which restarting a level with ice/mud doesn't add the ice/mud demonstration to the puzzle glossary upon level completion.

In other news, Maze Burrow will be [b]50% off[/b] during the Steam Halloween sale! If you have yet to pick up a copy, whether it's for yourself or for a friend, the Halloween sale is a great time to do so. 

Keep at it, burrowers!

- Kimimaru

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - August 9, 2020
notes.notes:
Hello Burrowers,

Update 1.0.3 is here, bringing a few fixes and minor improvements based on your feedback!

[list]
[*] Fixed audio crackling issues with certain drivers and Linux distros. This was related to how the audio was compressed. Due to the change in audio compression settings, all music tracks now take up more disk space.
[*] One bonus level was slightly adjusted to reduce how many moving parts the player has to keep track of.
[*] Added an acknowledgement upon 100% completion.
[/list]

Thanks again for your feedback; I hope you all enjoy this update!

- Kimimaru

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - May 9, 2020
notes.notes:
Hello Burrowers,

Update 1.0.2 is here, bringing some further quality of life improvements to Maze Burrow 1.01, which was released just yesterday!

[list]
[*] The Main and Alternative set of keyboard controls have been resurrected. This time, both sets of controls are rebindable.
[*] [b]P[/b] is now the default pause button in the Alternative set of keyboard controls.
[*] The backspace key now displays as "[b]Backspc[/b]" to avoid confusion with the input action named "Back".
[*] The "[b]Stats[/b]" HUD display option has been renamed to "[b]MovesTime[/b]" for consistency with the other options.
[/list]

From now on, game versions will follow a more traditional version format of "1.1.1".

I hope you all enjoy this update!

- Kimimaru

notes.title: Update 1.01 - May 8
notes.notes:
Hello Burrowers,

Update 1.01 is here, bringing some quality of life improvements to Maze Burrow, based on your feedback!

[list]
[*] Keyboard controls are now rebindable. As a result, there's now one keyboard config instead of two.
[*] The default controls have been adjusted. Movement directions for gamepads default to [b]D-pad[/b] inputs, and the undo button defaults to [b]Backspace[/b] on keyboard.
[*] It's now possible to undo a move while grabbing (but not moving) a block.
[*] You can now hold the undo button to repeatedly undo instead of pressing it each time.
[*] The max number of moves you can undo has been increased from 30 to 60 to help with later levels.
[*] There's a new HUD Display setting that allows you to turn certain parts of the HUD on or off inside levels.
[*] The [b]ControllerMappings.txt[/b] file that helps the game utilize unsupported gamepads is now read from the local application data directory. If it does not exist there, the game will copy the existing one in the install folder over for you at startup.
[*] Minor fix in the gamepad control screen's selection when backing out of it if the rightmost column was previously selected.
[/list] 

Thanks again for your feedback and support, and I hope you all enjoy this update!

- Kimimaru
